Top review: I was very pleased with the Rollater. I have trouble with my balance and felt very secure walking with it. The only problem I had was folding it. This really helps. Thank you! Also thank you for the fast delivery. I got it the next day after ordering it. Was easy for me to assemble.must be tall for use of this walker...not returnable if open box and remove packaging...Calif law? very sad purchase when cannot return, so must sell or give to a tall person who needs. ## Product guides and documents

## Product Description 

 The Drive Medical portable rollator walker with seat continues to lead the charge when it comes to design, quality, and value. A mobility aid in a league all of its own, this 4-wheeled adult walker comes highly recommended by those who seek strength, support, durability, and comfort, all mixed with a touch of class. This walker with seat and wheels comes complete with a hinged padded backrest, which can be removed by folding it up or down. This indoor and outdoor walker also boasts comfortable seating along with a convenient pouch, which you can use to store personal items. 6-inch non-marring wheel casters are ideal for both indoor and outdoor use, as are the easy-to-use deluxe loop locks. But that’s not all; ergonomic handles can be adjusted according to your height, making gripping the handles of this medical walker incredibly convenient and comfortable while eliminating undue stress on hands and joints. With the 4-wheel rollator walker as your travel companion, there is no need to overstretch yourself because this standing walker doubles as a comfortable chair, allowing you to rest and refresh yourself anywhere and at any time. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty from Drive Medical, a leading brand of mobility aids and other medical goods for more than 20 years, you can purchase with confidence.

To use the walker, adjust the height of the handles using the easy-turn lever to fit your height. The walker can be folded and unfolded for easy storage and transportation. ## Description
The Drive Medical portable rollator walker with seat continues to lead the charge when it comes to design, quality, and value. A mobility aid in a league all of its own, this 4-wheeled adult walker comes highly recommended by those who seek strength, support, durability, and comfort, all mixed with a touch of class. This walker with seat and wheels comes complete with a hinged padded backrest, which can be removed by folding it up or down. This indoor and outdoor walker also boasts comfortable seating along with a convenient pouch, which you can use to store personal items. 7.5-inch non-marring wheel casters are ideal for both indoor and outdoor use, as are the easy-to-use deluxe loop locks. But that’s not all; ergonomic handles can be adjusted according to your height, making gripping the handles of this medical walker incredibly convenient and comfortable while eliminating undue stress on hands and joints. With the 4-wheel rollator walker as your travel companion, there is no need to overstretch yourself because this standing walker doubles as a comfortable chair, allowing you to rest and refresh yourself anywhere and at any time. Backed by a limited lifetime warranty from Drive Medical, a leading brand of mobility aids and other medical goods for more than 20 years, you can purchase with confidence.
